commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Kess, Dissident Mage ({1}{U}{B}{R} 3/4 flying legendary Human Wizard; New Capenna Commander, set ncc, released 2022-04-29; commander-legal, not a Game Changer, no project exception). Oracle: once during each of your turns, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your graveyard; if a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Plan (owner 2026-10-14 rebuild): a spells-in-graveyard turbo shell. Kess doubles every instant/sorcery once per own turn: recast Demonic Consultation / Tainted Pact in response to Thassa's Oracle's trigger, a second tutor, ritual, wheel or Final Fortune; fill the graveyard with Entomb, Intuition, Gifts Ungiven, Faithless Looting, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ledger Shredder; Displacer Kitten blinks Kess for a new permission; Snapcaster Mage covers opponents' turns. Secondary: Underworld Breach + Lion's Eye Diamond / Lotus Petal + Brain Freeze or Grinding Station; Reanimate. Candidate adds Mana Drain, an own-turn Kess recast that refunds mana.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 5 (fringe cEDH; owner-approved), unchanged. Game Changers: 21 in both baseline and candidate (Ad Nauseam, Ancient Tomb, Chrome Mox, Demonic Tutor, Fierce Guardianship, Force of Will, Gamble, Gifts Ungiven, Grim Monolith, Imperial Seal, Intuition, Lion's Eye Diamond, Mana Vault, Mox Diamond, Mystical Tutor, Necropotence, Orcish Bowmasters, Rhystic Study, Thassa's Oracle, Underworld Breach, Vampiric Tutor). Kess tournament results are thin (EDHTop16 one-year 58 entries, conversion 0.1207; stats.cedh.events 87 decklists, conversion 16.1%, flagged low sample).
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Kess's Oracle: the one add is an instant Kess can recast on her own turn with a same-turn mana refund. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the registry Archidekt exports, candidate/baseline): Kefka, Court Mage 80/80; Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge 77/78; Inalla, Archmage Ritualist 71/71; Evelyn, the Covetous 71/71. The overlap is the Grixis cEDH staple core (fast mana, tutors, free counters, Thassa's Oracle / Underworld Breach). Kess-unique against all four in the candidate: Deadly Rollick, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Fiery Islet, Gifts Ungiven, Grinding Station, Ledger Shredder, Mana Drain, Snapcaster Mage, Training Center. The swap lowers overlap: Personal Tutor is shared with Jeleva; Mana Drain is in none of the four. Owner-removed or rejected cards and classes (Consider, Jeska's Will, Flame of Anor, Past in Flames, Yawgmoth's Will, Mizzix's Mastery, Thousand-Year Storm, Professor Onyx, Talrand, Guttersnipe, Young Pyromancer, the Hoarding Broodlord package, The One Ring, Opposition Agent, Dauthi Voidwalker, Frantic Search, Birgi, Chaos Warp, Sensei's Divining Top, Cursed Totem and the other 2026-10-14 cuts) are not re-added; Jeska's Will and Frantic Search appear only as staged owner-decision alternatives.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 library cards were reviewed (99 rows; no basics; 100 distinct names). The baseline is the owner's 2026-10-14 41-card rebuild; owner additions include Personal Tutor, Demonic Counsel, Displacer Kitten, Fellwar Stone, Grinding Station, City of Traitors and Windfall; explicitly accepted second-pass keeps are Reanimate, Displacer Kitten, Gifts Ungiven, Demonic Counsel and Valley Floodcaller. Candidate roles: 27 lands; 10 creatures (Displacer Kitten, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ledger Shredder, Orcish Bowmasters, Ragavan, Simian Spirit Guide, Snapcaster Mage, Spellseeker, Thassa's Oracle, Valley Floodcaller); 30 instants and 13 sorceries; 15 artifacts (Arcane Signet, Chrome Mox, Fellwar Stone, Grim Monolith, Grinding Station, Lion's Eye Diamond, Lotus Petal, Mana Vault, Mox Diamond, Mox Opal, Sol Ring, three Talismans, Wishclaw Talisman); 4 enchantments (Mystic Remora, Necropotence, Rhystic Study, Underworld Breach). Stack suite after the add: Force of Will, Force of Negation, Fierce Guardianship, Pact of Negation, Flusterstorm, Swan Song, Mental Misstep, Mindbreak Trap, Pyroblast, Red Elemental Blast, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Deflecting Swat, Mana Drain.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 27 lands unchanged (land colour sources U21/B18/R19 with fetches counted for every colour they can find; colourless-only: Ancient Tomb, City of Traitors, Gemstone Caverns). 72 nonland cards; candidate curve MV0 6, MV1 26, MV2 21, MV3 12, MV4 5, MV5 2; average nonland MV 1.86 (baseline 1.85: one fewer MV1, one more MV2). Bounded P(Kess castable with UBR by turn 3-6) 0.12/0.36/0.45/0.53 conservative (lands and colour rocks only), unchanged by the swap. Mana Drain needs {U}{U}.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Thirteen stack-interaction cards (most free or one mana), Orcish Bowmasters, Toxic Deluge, Deadly Rollick, Into the Flood Maw / Chain of Vapor / Otawara bounce. Weak to graveyard hate (Kess, Breach, Reanimate) and to Rule of Law-style effects. Mana Drain adds a hard counter that Kess can replay on your turn.

material_candidates.role: {U}{U} instant: counter target spell; at the beginning of your next main phase add {C} equal to its mana value.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Personal Tutor is an owner addition from the 2026-10-14 rebuild (one of the 41 adds; not in the adversarial second pass and not spine-named). {U} sorcery: search for a sorcery and put it on top of the library. It cannot find the instant win pieces (Demonic Consultation, Tainted Pact, Brain Freeze), puts the card on top rather than in hand (a dead draw step unless paired with a draw), and overlaps Mystical Tutor (instant, any instant or sorcery) inside a 14-card tutor suite. Lowest adoption in the 99: EDHREC cEDH 26/387 (6.7%); absent from the stats.cedh.events 61-card staple list; no EDHTop16 aggregate row. Alternative cut (staged, owner-respecting): Deadly Rollick, a free exile spell retained from the original list (not an owner addition; EDHREC cEDH 106/387).
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Kess recasts it from the graveyard on her own turn (paid {U}{U}, normal timing): cast in the precombat main phase or combat, its mana arrives in the postcombat main phase of the same turn (Mana Drain ruling 2020-11-10), so a protected combo turn refunds mana. From hand it is a hard counter at instant speed on any turn. It is a blue card for Force of Will / Force of Negation pitch, keeping the blue count at 26.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: UU is the strictest blue cost among the counters (bounded P(UU available) turn 2-6 0.50/0.67/0.74/0.80/0.84). Kess gives no permission on opponents' turns, so the graveyard recast only works against spells cast during your turn. Delirium proxy drops by at most about 1.5 points (Personal Tutor is a sorcery; Mana Drain an instant). Spellbook 6 -> 6. Owner-direction flag: the cut overrides an owner addition; fallback +Mana Drain -Deadly Rollick staged.
material_candidates.reason: The one genuine swap: the most-played non-incumbent interaction card for Kess (EDHREC cEDH 60.5%, cEDH events 51.7%) replaces the least-played card in the 99, with an own-turn Kess recast that refunds mana. Owner-addition override flagged; owner-respecting fallback staged.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: One swap: +Mana Drain -Personal Tutor. It gives up a top-of-library sorcery tutor that overlaps Mystical Tutor for a hard counter that Kess can replay on her own turn with a same-turn mana refund. Game Changers stay at 21; lands stay at 27; blue count stays at 26; Spellbook combos stay at 6. Owner-addition override flagged; the owner-respecting fallback +Mana Drain -Deadly Rollick is staged.

withdrawal_reason: RESEARCH_ONLY: one genuine swap (+Mana Drain -Personal Tutor), below the five-swap owner-presentation floor. Pass C's requested tests (+Jeska's Will over Ledger Shredder, +Frantic Search over Personal Tutor) were run in bounded form; both adds were cut by the owner on 2026-10-14 and remain owner decisions. Grim Tutor over Demonic Counsel is staged as an owner decision. Every other candidate is dominated in the same slot (Spell Pierce, Muddle the Mixture, Lim-Dûl's Vault), overrides an owner keep without clear evidence (Notion Thief, Narset, Parter of Veils, Hexing Squelcher, Mnemonic Betrayal), is marginal (Praetor's Grasp, Cyclonic Rift, Undercity Sewers, Snap, Exotic Orchard, Urza's Saga, Dispel, Lightning Bolt), anti-synergistic (Timetwister), owner-rejected (The One Ring, Opposition Agent, Dauthi Voidwalker) or invalid (Manamorphose, Silence off-identity). The five-swap floor is not met without padding. This packet is NOT owner-presentable and NOT owner approved; the canonical Kess, Dissident Mage list is unchanged.
